message: ごめんね

name: Shio
message: 「Splendid work. You have successfully subdued the spirit, indeed.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Against a small fry like that, it's a total piece of cake once we get our hands on it!」

name: Shio
message: 「The three of you were in complete sync. There was no room for this humble one to step in. I must train even harder!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Synn. Maybe all those fights we got into as kids are actually paying off.」

name: Synn
message: 「Look who's talking. You were always picking on me, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tahahaha, that was just tough love! Statute of limitations is way up by now!」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh, come to think of it, Elder Sister and I used to have sisterly quarrels quite often as well.」

name: Misa
message: 「Eh? Y-Yeah, we did...!」

name: Shio
message: 「Yes! Perhaps the fundamentals of combat lie in such unexpected places.」

name: Sally
message: 「Phew, finally all done. Prez, where are we stopping by on the way home tonight? What are we gonna eat?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-We don't grab snacks on the way home every single night, you know?」
Chatting casually, we head toward the meeting spot.
There haven't been any urgent reports from Ria-senpai or Lolotte, so their patrol must have gone smoothly. That wraps up today's patrol.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Brrr, it's freezing! It's already kotatsu season, huh.」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa? What's wrong, you seem... Aah!」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What is it!?」

name: Synn
message: 「My shoelace is untied!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't yell about it, just tie it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, I'm going on ahead.」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tahahaha, always weirdly conscientious about the strangest things.」
With my shoelace still untied, I jog ahead for a few dozen meters.
Because by the time I crouch down and tie it properly, Misa and the others will catch up.
Running in a weird way so he wouldn't trip, Sakura-kun went on ahead.
He could have just retied his shoelaces right there, though according to Nanaka-san, he's always been like that.
We step outside the school building and walk toward the front gate.
Without really thinking, I look up at the clear December sunset sky.
It's hard to believe this is the exact same sky I saw at last year's Holy Night Festival.
...The sky hasn't changed; I'm the one who has.
I'm scared...
I feel bewildered by how strongly I'm being drawn to Sakura-kun.
When our Student Council was first formed, he was nothing more than a rival, yet before I knew it, I had fallen for him.
How can I go back to the days when I only saw him as a rival?
I don't know.
Without realizing it, my pace has slowed down.
So that I won't catch up to Sakura-kun...?

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Tehe.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hehe...」
We exchange a smile.
Just how hypocritical of an expression am I wearing right now?

name: Nanaka
message: 「M-Maybe I should run too. I want to stick close to Synn and be his windbreak...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tahahaha, scrapped! That's way too obvious. Besides, up until now, I've always been the one using Synn as a windbreak.」

name: Misa
message: 「G-Geez... Honestly, Nanaka-san.」
My chest gives a sharp throb. Even taking a hit from a demon doesn't hurt like this.
Foolish as I am, even though I supposedly gave up on Sakura-kun, I still haven't been able to move on.

name: Shio
message: 「Older Sister, let us walk closely together as well.」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh? Y-Yeah, sure.」

name: Sally
message: 「Yay, I'm gonna stick super close to Shio-chi too!」
Earlier, Shio had sung the praises of the teamwork between Sakura-kun, Nanaka-san, and me.
Sakura-kun trusts everyone unconditionally.
And because Nanaka-san believes in me too, we can fight with our hearts completely in sync.
Compared to them, I'm a liar...
I don't like Sakura-kun at all. I'll help bring the two of you together-I just keep telling that lie.
...Even so, what am I supposed to do about it now?
There's no way I can tell her that I'm in love with Sakura-kun too!
Ugh, how did things end up like this!?
It's because Nanaka-san asked me, 'Do you like Synn?'--
If only she had asked, 'Do you hate Synn?' back then--
If she had, none of this would have...
I shake my head, dismissing the selfish what-if. Isn't there a better way to handle this?
Sakura-kun, Nanaka-san, and me. Couldn't we just stay friends, keeping the wonderful relationship we have right now?
That's an even more naive thought than the hypothetical I just brushed aside.
At first, I didn't like Sakura-kun at all.
Sakura-kun is probably still the same Sakura-kun I've always known. He hasn't changed.
He's a serious hard worker, steadily putting his all into both the Student Council and his studies.
He's gaining real ability and growing. But that's not the side of him that's troubling me.
I'm the one who changed...
Before I knew it, Onee-sama had become someone I admired-someone close to me whom I truly respected.
At the same time, Sakura-kun slipped into my heart without asking and carved out a space of his own.
A space shaped just like Sakura-kun--
Surely the exact same thing that exists inside Nanaka-san's heart.
I'm going to keep changing.
Sakura-kun and Nanaka-san will keep changing at their own pace, too.
Thinking we can just stay like this forever is way too naive.
A sudden question crosses my mind.
'Changing' and 'not changing.'
What is Nanaka-san and Sakura-kun's relationship like?
No, no, I need to settle my own feelings first!

name: Shio
message: 「...Elder Sister?」

name: Shio
message: 「Nwooooh!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Awawawa! Shio-chi, why are you hugging me?!」

name: Shio
message: 「Ooh, just as I suspected. Young children truly do have higher body temperatures.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see! Sally-chan is way better than using Synn as a windbreak.」

name: Sally
message: 「Waaah! Don't all gang up and squeeze me like this!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Uha, Sally-chan is so toasty! You're the Demon World's idol and a hot water bottle.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on, come on, get over here too, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「Heehee, take this! Squeeze♪」

name: Sally
message: 「Hahi~ It's so hot and stuffy in here!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, you all look nice and warm. Let me join in on the group hug--」
Sakura-kun comes running back from over there.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Pervert!」

name: Misa
message: 「Pervert!」

name: Shio
message: 「H-How shameless!」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That's so mean」

name: Misa
message: 「Heehee」
Why do we have to change? I wish we could stay like this forever...!

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh my, how rare」

name: Helena
message: 「Hii, it's Helena\s04 Good work today, everyone」
When we arrived at the meeting spot, Helena-san was there to greet us.

name: Ria
message: 「Big Sis... is it tonight?」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, it's about time we settled things once and for all」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, I believe in you, okay?\s07」

name: Misa
message: 「What are you talking about?」
Ria-senpai seems to know the reason why Helena-san is here.

name: Lolotte
message: 「So excited, so thrilled\s07 If the Chairwoman is here, that means we're getting free meat bun vouchers, right?♪」

name: Sally
message: 「Yay, yay! Meat buns, pizza buns, curry buns~♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Red bean buns, chocolate buns, custard buns~♪」

name: Helena
message: 「I don't have any, you know?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehh」

name: Sally
message: 「No way!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There is nothing left to do but die...」

name: Sally
message: 「No, no, I don't wanna die! I wanna live, I wanna live, I wanna live and eat lots of steamed buns, waaah!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Lolotte-chan, Sally-chan, wake up. You two are being deceived!」

name: Helena
message: 「Think about it. How thick the dough on a steamed bun is, and how tiny a bit of filling is inside」

name: Shio
message: 「N-Now that you mention it... that practically amounts to fraud」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, no, that's just how they are. Something packed solid with filling and super thin skin isn't a steamed bun at all!」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah, yeah! Feed me a fluffy, piping-hot steamed bun! *Flail, flail*」

name: Helena
message: 「Instead, I had oden made out in the Kujou family garden. Everyone, go ahead and eat.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Okaaay, I'll stop dying now♪ Mr. Oden, simmer, simmer, simmer\s07」

name: Shio
message: 「Splendid indeed. After midwinter training, nothing beats pork miso soup or oden.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, eating it outdoors on a cold night makes it taste extra good.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I like soup kitchens like this too. Feels like a festival.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sounds fun. Thank you for the meal. Though Helena-san, why oden?」

name: Helena
message: 「Because our academy is a Christian mission school, after all.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You don't get it, Vice President? It's the classic 'East of Eden, West of Oden.'」

name: Helena
message: 「Exactly right, Lolotte-chan.」

name: Ria
message: 「Big Sis, making a pun like that on such an important night...」

name: Sally
message: 「Sniff, sniff, sniff. Something smells really good over here!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hwah! That person is--」

name: Melilot
message: 「Hee~hee-hee-hee!」
Like a witch brewing some bizarre potion in a giant cauldron, Melilot-san stands entranced in front of the oden pot.

name: Ria
message: 「M-Melilot-san...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Hah!? P-Pardon me. Whenever I see a bubbling, simmering liquid, I just...」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, that looks delicious. Did you make it, Melilot-san?」

name: Melilot
message: 「No, I am merely tending the fire. Riesling did the cooking.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How's that, hmph!」

name: Helena
message: 「Melilot, leave the rest to me and please take care of Synn-chan.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. Sakura-kun, over here.」

name: Synn
message: 「You need something from me?」
Melilot-san beckons me over to a spot a few meters away from everyone else.

name: Helena
message: 「Everyone, relax and listen while you eat」

name: Helena
message: 「Ahem... You have all worked tirelessly day after day in your duties as Crusaders」

name: Helena
message: 「With the Demons growing bolder ahead of Re-Crea, I have heard from my younger sister Ria of your selfless devotion and heroic efforts」

name: Helena
message: 「Thanks to all of you, our forces and the Demons are evenly matched, yet I urge you not to let your guard down for a moment」

name: Helena
message: 「In other words, the current situation lacks a decisive blow--it is a perilous stalemate where the Demons could run rampant at any moment」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Nom, nom. Mr. Kinchaku is like a lucky grab bag. You never know what's inside until you eat it」

name: Shio
message: 「Munch, munch... Ohh, this is a ginkgo nut. 'Tis one that I gathered together with Sir Jeeves」

name: Sally
message: 「Ginkgo nuts are stinky, yucky-poo. Still love eating 'em, though~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Out of all the oden ingredients, wieners are my absolute favorite. Tahahaha, even if that's total heresy」

name: Misa
message: 「E-Everyone, let's listen properly to what she's saying」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufufu, don't worry, Misa-chan. Everything up to here was just the preamble. The main topic starts now--」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun, please come closer to my side」

name: Synn
message: 「Sure, I don't mind, why?」

name: Helena
message: 「As the art of war states: know the enemy and know yourself, and in a hundred battles you will never be in peril」

name: Helena
message: 「The Crusaders fight using the Spirit Power of Guardian Angels, whereas the Demons wield magic」

name: Helena
message: 「Spirit Arts and magic. These two are fundamentally incompatible. Thus, we have been unable to grasp the Demons' hand」

name: Helena
message: 「However, Ria, Melilot, and I scoured ancient texts day and night, and at last we discovered a method to break this deadlock」

name: Helena
message: 「Truly a godsend! Believe it or not, there exists a technique that lets even humans blast out magic! With this, you're all gonna get even stronger!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Th-That's insane!! That's a shocking revelation that'll shake the Three Realms!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Now then, with that said, Synn-chan, whip up some magic right quick for us, won't you\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't have the slightest clue how to do it, though...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun, what is your favorite food?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I will teach you how to draw a magic circle. What is your favorite food?」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um, what does magic have to do with my favorite food?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Listen, Master Synn. What this woman is saying actually makes some sense, you know?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Magic is merely one form of manifesting your own magical power. It is not a matter of simply chanting fixed incantations, like when borrowing Spirit Power from a Guardian Angel.」

name: Paqy
message: 「In other words, magic doesn't have an unchanging formula like an equation.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Think back on the magic of the guys you've fought up till now. Every single one of 'em was self-taught, right?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Precisely. Please use the image most pleasing to you as a vessel, and channel your magical power into it.」

name: Synn
message: 「B-But what do we do if a magic circle appears? I don't know how to control it!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Do not be so tense. What we are trying right now is the absolute basics. There is no danger.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that so... Ah! That's why you asked about my favorite food, since it's something I can picture right away.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, magical power is formless. It is only through one's own thought that one's magical power takes the shape of a magic circle.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah! If you're vaguely feeling magical power inside yourself, Master Synn, try giving it shape with a clear image. Ain't nothing difficult about it.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'll give it a try.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hnnnn, hnnnn...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Nothing is happening at all, is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'll try one more time.」

name: Synn
message: 「Favorite food, favorite food...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, since Synn lives so frugally, maybe he doesn't even know what his favorite food is?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that it?! I ate it on my birthday, sure, but to me beefsteak is practically a mythical food!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「...You may also picture a girl you like, you know?」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun...」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa...」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I did it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh... that's Synn... right?」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun...」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez is awesome! Boss doesn't even hold a candle to him!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-Is that really the president?」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um, something's overflowing from inside me... and, well, both my arms are tingling and the magic circle is getting hot...」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It feels really bad, though」

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama, raise your arms straight up and picture fireworks. That's the safest way.」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Okay」

name: Synn
message: 「The night sky turned into a blue sky for an instant. M-Magic is amazing.」

name: Melilot
message: 「You're mistaken. The one who is amazing is you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then everyone else can become amazing too. Anyone can learn to use magic, right?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Humans cannot wield magic.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn...?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-Is that Sakura-kun... really?」

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong, why are you two making such weird faces? Sure, the magic was outrageous, but it's safe now--」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's not it. Resonating with the magic circle awakened the dormant potential inside you.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Can't blame you for not noticing yourself, Synn-sama, but your appearance... it's changed, y'know?」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, please stay calm and listen, okay?」

name: Ria
message: 「We were testing you, Synn-kun.」

name: Helena
message: 「Only Demons can handle magic circles. You're a Demon, aren't you, Synn-chan?」

name: Synn
message: 「Gulp!!」

name: Helena
message: 「And what's more, you're the Demon Lord, aren't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「G-Gulp!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha...」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way... I'm not strong like the Demon Lord, and, um...!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Then who was it that unleashed that tremendous magic just now?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, that's...」

name: Helena
message: 「Now then, everyone. The Demon Lord is among us」

name: Helena
message: 「...I am going to ask a few questions now. I want you all to answer honestly」

name: Helena
message: 「No, lying is fine too. Depending on the tendencies of your answers, the target will naturally be narrowed down」

name: Synn
message: 「Gulp...」

name: Helena
message: 「First, then, Mr. Demon Lord」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, Synn...」

name: Synn
message: 「C-Crap!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-Huh? Why is there a red light between Synn's eyebrows?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Lord Demon Lord, a laser pointer's aimed at you」

name: Helena
message: 「Tamiko, you're being far too hasty」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Jiiya, please don't snipe the President!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's gone... Phew」

name: Misa
message: 「P-Paqy just called him Lord Demon Lord...」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, I--」
For a few moments, I feel a crushing pressure across the skin of my entire body, as if the surrounding air has condensed and pressed in against me.
And then, a sense of release.
The December night air, and the delicious smell of oden simmering away in the pot.

name: Synn
message: 「W-What is it?」

name: Shio
message: 「Lord Synn has returned to his usual self!」

name: Melilot
message: 「It seems he still cannot control the manifestation of his magic or his follow-through. This is going to be tough work, Helena.」

name: Helena
message: 「His latent power is extraordinary, though.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Certainly, the Demon Lord's power will be necessary to bring Re-Crea to a peaceful conclusion. However, Sakura-kun is still far too inexperienced...」

name: Synn
message: 「My... power?」

name: Helena
message: 「Isn't it your job to whip Synn-chan into shape, Melilot? Ufufu\s04 You're good at drilling people hard, aren't you?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please refrain from phrasing it in such a misleading way!」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, I'm just so happy♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. Because Synn-kun became the Demon Lord while still staying Synn-kun, right?\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Umm...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, the President is flustered as usual. He steps up when it counts, but aside from that, he is a total wimp.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Totally! I freaked out a bit when Synn turned into some cosplay-looking Demon Lord and blasted magic everywhere, but that's all it was.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my? You've got some wonderful underclassmen, Ria. These kids accepted Synn-chan without a second thought.」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, the Demon Lord and us Crusaders are bound together by destiny, after all.」

name: Ria
message: 「No, even without that, we definitely would've all come together anyway♪」

name: Helena
message: 「When crisis threatens the three worlds through Re-Crea, the Demon Lord and the inheritors of the Rosary are naturally drawn to one another.」

name: Helena
message: 「And so, after joining forces to protect the world, each returns to their own life.」

name: Melilot
message: 「This Re-Crea is the first mutation in over twenty years. You have all crossed paths with the Demon Lord. What this fact signifies is clear.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun, starting tomorrow, I will train you into a full-fledged Demon Lord. I will show no leniency.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Steel your resolve tonight. Decide whether to step forward or step down of your own free will and responsibility.」

name: Synn
message: 「If I can be of help, I'll gladly do the training.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yep, yep, that's so like Synn. His decisiveness at times like this is amazing.」

name: Ria
message: 「I have to apologize.」

name: Ria
message: 「The reason I kept quiet about Synn-kun is because I couldn't be sure whether the Demon Lord actually existed.」

name: Ria
message: 「If he didn't exist, it would prove that this Re-Crea wouldn't be anything major. I didn't want to make everyone worry unnecessarily.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come to think of it, what do you think about Synn, Sally-chan? Like, absolute obedience or something?」

name: Sally
message: 「No way, no way! Even if people call him the Demon Lord, he doesn't feel like one at all. Honestly, I couldn't care less.」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't know whether to be happy or sad...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If the Demon Lord is the President, there's nothing to worry about--it's actually a huge relief. Rather than such a trivial matter, the oden getting cold is a much bigger crisis.」

name: Sally
message: 「Waaah! I left the heat on, and it's about to boil to mush!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please leave the simmering of My Lady's oden ingredients to this butler, Riesling Tooyama.」

name: Helena
message: 「Hehe, I knew you'd show up, Tamiko-chan.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please keep an eye on the heat for us.」

name: Misa
message: 「--Wait just a minute!」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I... won't accept this!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, you've been... all this time」

name: Misa
message: 「You've been deceiving us all along, haven't you!?」

name: Misa
message: 「See, you can't even say anything! Don't make a fool out of me!!」

name: Misa
message: 「P-Please... say something back. If you don't, I'll... about you...」

name: Misa
message: 「And yet, you treated me like...!」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm... going home!!」
Misa runs off.
The night we ate dinner together at Tsukinoo Park, the night we studied for tests in my room--our fun autumn together.
Misa acted all prickly, but I think she was happy. At times like those, she would always run off home.
Tonight she's running too, overwhelmed with emotion. Yet the feelings driving her are the exact opposite of back in autumn.

name: Synn
message: 「It's my fault...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I already know that! What the hell are you dawdling around for!? Hurry up and go after her!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah!」

name: Misa
message: 「What is it! Don't follow me!!」
Surprisingly, I catch up to Misa while still on the academy grounds.
Misa was trembling faintly and had stopped running.
Whether it was from the winter cold, anger, or heartache... there were too many possible reasons for me to pinpoint what was causing it.

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, wait!」
I grabbed Misa by both shoulders and pulled her toward me.
Because her trembling showed no sign of stopping, and I was terrified that if I left her like this, all of Misa would fragilely crumble away.

name: Misa
message: 「--Don't touch me!!」
My hands were slapped away.

name: Synn
message: 「I wasn't... deceiving everyone, or you, Misa...」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, yes! I'm sure you weren't! Sakura-kun didn't betray the Crusaders either!」

name: Misa
message: 「But that's all!!」

name: Misa
message: 「To think Sakura-kun was the Demon Lord...! You hid it until this very moment!? Ever since we first met!?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No! I only found out that I was the Demon Lord pretty recently!」

name: Misa
message: 「W-When...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Right on... the day our Student Council was established...」

name: Misa
message: 「Hold on, isn't that...」

name: Misa
message: 「Isn't that the very day the Crusaders were formed! You kept it completely hidden from the very beginning of our demon extermination to the very end!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah, because----」

name: Misa
message: 「Why would you keep something so important... In the end, you didn't trust me--」

name: Misa
message: 「You didn't trust any of us, did you!?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not true!」

name: Synn
message: 「I was scared of what everyone would think of me!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, if it were just me being hated, that would still be fine」

name: Synn
message: 「But if you found out I was the Demon Lord... I was terrified to even imagine what would happen to the relationship we'd worked so hard to build」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't blame it on us!」

name: Misa
message: 「You... coward, Sakura-kun!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yo, can't ya run unless I give ya a push?」

name: Synn
message: 「I can run」

name: Misa
message: 「Huff, huff, huff...!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wheeze, huff, wheeze, huff」

name: Misa
message: 「Jeez, just leave me alone!」

name: Synn
message: 「No way」

name: Misa
message: 「Huff, huff, huff! I-If you follow me all the way home, I won't forgive you! I'll tell everyone on you!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wheeze, huff, wheeze. Tell them if you want. You alone matter way more to me than everyone else」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I-I-Idiot!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Because you hated demons so much without even knowing what the Demon Lord was really like...」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... That's why I couldn't tell you...」

name: Synn
message: 「So that you wouldn't hate me... I...」

name: Misa
message: 「Hated by me... You, Sakura-kun...?」
Misa finally stops in her tracks.

name: Synn
message: 「That's because I...」

name: Synn
message: 「Because I love you, Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「Because I love you!!」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What's with you, Sakura-kun... That's not fair, pulling something like this...」

name: Synn
message: 「I know it's asking too much for you to trust me」

name: Synn
message: 「But these feelings, at least, are real」

name: Misa
message: 「In truth, Sakura-kun, you've never once betrayed me...」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm sure... you trust me too, Sakura-kun...」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I... about you, Sakura-kun... b-but...」
Misa wears an expression she has never shown before.
No, it's the first time in my life I've ever seen a girl make a face like that.

name: Misa
message: 「S-Sakura-kun. Listen, I...」

name: Misa
message: 「...No. I just can't say it...」

name: Synn
message: 「...I see」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sorry, Misa」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'm back--hey, what're you standing around outside the room for?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Oh...! Yeah」

name: Paqy
message: 「The great me personally saw Hisa all the way home. Of course, she said her house's location is a secret from Synn-sama」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahaha, same as always. That's just like Misa」

name: Synn
message: 「You didn't get to eat any oden, Paqy」

name: Paqy
message: 「Forget about that stuff and pipe down. Give worrying about other people a rest, just for tonight」

name: Paqy
message: 「The way you are right now, Synn-sama, it's okay to think only about yourself, y'know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Paqy
message: 「C'mon, let's get inside. You're gonna catch a cold brooding out here like this」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy. Even when it's just the two of us, you call me 'Synn-sama' instead of 'Demon Lord'」

name: Paqy
message: 「Just shut up and get in already! Jeez!!」
